sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent no.2 also accepts notice.
Respondent no.2 affirms that the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have been granted divorce by mutual consent vide Decree of Divorce dated 14.08.2023.
She further affirms the Memorandum of Understanding dated 03.07.2023 and submits that she has voluntarily settled all disputes with the petitioners.

She further affirms that petitioner no.1 has already paid her a sum of Rs.30,00,000/-, and the remaining amount of Rs.15,00,000/- have been handed over to the respondent no.2 in Court today vide DD no.12387 in full and final settlement of all her claims including alimony, stridhan etc..
She further states that she does not wish to pursue the criminal proceedings against the petitioners and has no objection to the quashing of the present FIR.

7. In view of the fact that the present FIR was lodged as a result of matrimonial discord between the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 which have since been settled between the parties, and as the respondent no.2 does not wish to continue with the criminal proceedings, in order to bring a quietus to the present disputes and following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & This is a digitally signed order.
